What each carries

A junction is next when it is the task's next applicable gate, passed when the status stands at or after it, and later otherwise. A group of more than eight rows shows its first three and folds the rest.

The owner arrives with each section open and each gate group that holds a next junction unfolded; every provenance stays folded until asked for. An assignee arrives with their own section open and the others folded, and an observer sees the People table alone.

  • Tableau: the whole project by gate
  • My corner: a person’s tasks among their neighbours
  • Blockage: what waits on what
  • History: who did what, when
  • Audit: the model each commit ran against the model its junction states
  • Gates: the legend for every symbol
